occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: The carbon monoxide detector was last tested in April 2026. Note: this was corrected at inspection when staff tested the detector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Documentation for Unitary Surfacing Materials (26 TAC §746.4913)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Drills: The director failed to document fire drills for the months of July, August and September 2025.

occurrences.finding: Health Statement on File within 1 Week of Admission: 1 out of 10 children's files  is missing the health statement.

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal: The last Fire Marshal inspection was completed on 10/24/2024 and expired on 10/17/25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Conducted by Fire Marshal (26 TAC §746.5101(b))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- signed dated statement that employee attended abuse/neglect training: Two caregivers did not have the required information for receiving orientation. occurrences.violation_type_title: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months (26 TAC §746.1305(b))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §746.4135(b))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation: The operation did not have the most updated inspection report posted, the last inspection form posted was from 7/14/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements - Letter or form from the most recent Licensing Inspection or Investigation (26 TAC §746.401(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records-signed dated statement that employee received child care center's operational policies: Three caregiver did not have information that they received the center  policies.

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License (26 TAC §746.901(10))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A three year old child walked out of the classroom and walked to the classroom next door without the caregivers knowing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The director is not ensuring that the caregivers in the building are following minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was not good judgment of the caregivers when they allowed children to run around the classroom and allow children to walk around and eat popcorn.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: The school age children were watching a movie while eating snack.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Space Requirements - Under 18 Months of Age Separate from Older Children: They was a mixed age group of children in the lunch room in the morning, the ages of the children were 6  months to 3 years old. The youngest child from the oldest child was a 18 months difference.       Corrected:  When the infants went to their classroom and the rest of the children went to their classroom
occurrences.violation_type_title: Space Requirements - Under 18 Months of Age Separate from Older Children (26 TAC §746.4203)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three children are missing a health statement from their doctor.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: In one classroom their was 14 children with two caregivers. The youngest child was 10 months old and the oldest child was 3 years old. The oldest child was 18 months older then the youngest child.     Corrected:  When the two groups slip and the older children went to their classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One child is missing their immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the allegation of abuse.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the DFPS investigation, it was determined that a caregiver with access to children in care did not have a current eligible background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: It was determined through the DFPS investigation that caregivers present in the classroom did not intervene or report inappropriate discipline by another caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: 2 out of 6 infants on bottle only need written feeding instructions signed and dated by the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: During opening time, children are eating breakfast in the cafeteria and the tv is on showing age-appropriate programming.     Note: this was corrected at inspection when the caregiver turned off the tv.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records: During the investigation inspection, the person left in charge did have not access to all requested documentation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Access to All Records (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: Doing the follow up the child safety alarm was still observed not to be on when the van is turned on.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee verify all children accounted for (26 TAC §746.5625(d)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605: It was observed in the lunch room there was a caregiver caring for children, and her background showed pending.        Note: Caregiver background  is pending, Caregiver left the premises immediately.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Initial background checks submitted - At the time you become aware of anyone requiring a background check under 745.605 (26 TAC §745.621(a)(7))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A six-year-old child was left unsupervised in a center vehicle for over an hour.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: A list of children transported by the operation during transportation services was not completed.  The operation maintained attendance for children transported by the operation utilizing an electronic attendance system located at the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on the evidence obtained during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support the allegation of neglectful supervision. A child was left on the daycare van alone for over one hour.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Transportation (26 TAC §746.501(a)(14))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee verify all children accounted for: A six-year-old child was left sleeping in the center van when a caregiver failed to thoroughly conduct a visual check of the vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - Driver or designated employee verify all children accounted for (26 TAC §746.5625(d)(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: The operation failed to timely notify Child Care Regulation of a situation in which a child was placed at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Operation Open to Parents At All Times: Parents have been prevented from visiting their children inside the operation and/or go inside. The center has a COVID policy that says they cannot come in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Operation Open to Parents At All Times (26 TAC §746.201(7))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument: A child was popped on the hand by a caregiver as a form of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Hitting with Hand or Instrument (26 TAC §746.2805(4))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: In the toddler and infant classroom the lights were off during naptime and you were unable to see the children when walking into the classroom.       Corrected:  In the toddler classroom the caregiver turned on some lights to see the children while napping.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised: When the director came to answer the front door it was observed a caregiver sitting in the middle door way  of two different classrooms observing children napping.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised (26 TAC §746.2909(5))

The operation did not state in their emergency preparedness address of a alternate shelter away from the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two children did not have an address for their emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Nine Inches if Equipment Greater Than 5 Ft. (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One out of four children records reviewed is missing emergency contact information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One caregiver has an expired First Aid card. Expired on 10.4.2021.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))
